query:
DELETE FROM big_repo_keyhive_event_log
             WHERE scope_id = ?1
               AND seq <= ?2
               AND EXISTS (
                   SELECT 1
                     FROM big_repo_keyhive_admissions a
                    WHERE a.scope_id = big_repo_keyhive_event_log.scope_id
                      AND a.event_hash = big_repo_keyhive_event_log.event_hash
               )
